encoding.primitive_boundary: Encoder checkpoints include PM4 command head, uploaded-data tail and reserved footer space. On capacity exhaustion roll back all commands/data for the current primitive, seal the preceding IB and retry the same primitive in a fresh buffer. Never post a partial logical draw.
encoding.shader_state: Each primitive retains complete native state. Reset the per-IB border-table address on rollover; retain monotonically increasing flush sequence values across all buffers and retries.
encoding.topology: existing immutable index snapshot/primitive iterator preserves triangle strips/restart/winding and instance order across buffer boundaries
encoding.footer: reserve two command DWORDs per IB for the existing wait-write/idle footer
encoding.single_primitive_limit: If one complete primitive and its attachment copies cannot fit an empty64 KiB IB, return NoResources before any GPU submission
encoding.stack: Separate primitive expansion from nonrecursive raster state emission; no repeated draw() stack frame

resources.collections: Apple OSArray retains the private QcomGPUBuffer objects; OSData owns the trusted immutable16-byte address/word-count descriptors

resources.lifetime: all IB objects retained until real GPU retirement, or until a proved halt/drain on error; failed halt/address-space retirement retains/quarantines all command buffers
resources.command_snapshot: Single bounded OSData copy, at most2864 bytes, held only during CPU admission/encoding; replaces stacked command-array and shader-union copies

function_creation.implementation: Copy the native descriptor before CPU compilation or asynchronous dispatch; resolve original named AIR entry and typed effective constants through the existing compiler and program cache. specializedName belongs to the returned function object, not the shader/cache identity.
function_creation.options: None and FailOnBinaryArchiveMiss with no lookup archives. With lookup archives and fail-on-miss, return FunctionNotFound. Visible binary compilation, script recording, unknown flags and intersection functions return Unsupported.
function_creation.archive_hints: Original native binary archives are optional lookup hints; without fail-on-miss compile from original AIR. No Apple GPU binary is accepted as A540 code.
function_creation.missing_constants: Required constants must resolve even when descriptor.constantValues is nil; ordinary newFunctionWithName: reflection behavior remains.
function_creation.ownership: Returned function retains the same dynamic program and device as ordinary named specialization; alias names/options are per returned object.

pipeline_creation.implementation: Synchronous and asynchronous selectors share the same validated existing render/compute pipeline state, registered functions and native IOGPU backend. Descriptor snapshots are taken before asynchronous dispatch.
pipeline_creation.options: None creates supported pipelines. BindingInfo/BufferTypeInfo and unknown flags return Unsupported. FailOnBinaryArchiveMiss returns a cache-miss compilation error, permitting explicit caller fallback to AIR. Reflection outputs are initialized to nil; no substitute native reflection class is created.
pipeline_creation.compute_descriptor: Honor label, maximum group thread limit and execution-width-multiple promise. Cap each pipeline independently without mutating shared functions; reject an impossible fixed64-thread limit or execution-width limit. Validate the multiple promise when recording dispatch.

pipeline_creation.async_completion: Exactly one callback for accepted nonnil handlers on the default global dispatch queue, with a retained supported pipeline or NSError. This reports CPU pipeline creation only; GPU completion remains native fence-driven.
